Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 3
Order: Craft

A creative space for crafting useful items. It is equipped with six different kinds of Artisan's Tools chosen from: Carpenter's, Cobbler's, Glassblower's, Jeweler's, Leatherworker's, Mason's, Painter's, Potter's, Tinker's, Weaver's, and Woodcarver's Tools.

Craft Options. When you issue the Craft order to this facility, choose one of the following.

Craft: Adventuring Gear. The hirelings craft anything that can be made with the Workshop's tools, using the rules of the Player's Handbook.

Craft: Magic Item (Implement). If you are level 9+, the facility's hirelings can craft a Common or Uncommon magic item of your choice from the Implements tables of the Dungeon Master's Guide. The facility has the required tool, and the hirelings are proficient with it and with Arcana; use the Crafting Magic Items rules for the time and cost. If the item lets its user cast spells, you must craft it yourself (the hirelings can assist) and have those spells prepared every day you spend crafting.

Source of Inspiration. After spending an entire Short Rest in your Workshop, you gain Heroic Inspiration. You can't gain this benefit again until you finish a Long Rest.

Enlarging the Facility. For 2,000 GP, your Workshop becomes Vast and gains two more hirelings and three more kinds of Artisan's Tools from the list above.
